messages.subject: Relabelling discrete x-axis
parts:
I am trying to relabel the points on my x-axis from

0,1,2,3,4,5,6....
to
OPEN,1,2,3,4,5....,COMPLETE

I have tried doing this using scale_x_discrete but it tells me that
the labels argument is only suitable for slit data. Is there any way
to manually relabel the scale? Obviously I have tried relabelling in
the dataFrame and it reorders the points so they become meaningless.

Sorry if this question is trivial/duplicate and thank you very much
for a wonderful package.

Justin

messages.author: 13ff1921a4b26560
messages.subject: Re: Relabelling discrete x-axis
parts:
Hi Justin,
Without a reproducible example of what isn't working it is not so
clear how to fix your problem.
Relabelling should work for discrete or continuous data if you use
breaks and labels.

d <- data.frame(x = factor(0:6), y = rnorm(7))
ggplot(d, aes(x, y)) + geom_point() +
scale_x_discrete(breaks = c(0:6), labels = c("OPEN",1:5,"COMPLETE"))

d <- data.frame(x = 0:6, y = rnorm(7))
ggplot(d, aes(x, y)) + geom_point() +
scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0:6), labels = c("OPEN",
1:5,"COMPLETE"))
